jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the team

  • Plaid's Strategic Finance team plays a critical role in shaping our long-term business strategy and execution.

  • The Strategic Finance team helps provide analytical rigor and data-driven insights to drive success across the entire organization.

  • The Strategic Finance team's purpose is to support Plaid in achieving its short-term and long-term strategic & financial goals and help inform, articulate, and shape Plaid's growth trajectory.

About the role

You will own core pieces of Plaid's top-line revenue forecast and go beyond the number itself to understand what's actually driving it: internal data and external market factors that show how healthy and durable that growth is. You'll work day-to-day with our GTM organization, turning that analysis into insights they can act on. You are highly analytical and quantitative, comfortable building bottom-up from raw data as well as using Plaid's existing tools and dashboards to sanity-check the picture, and skilled at moving between complex modeling detail and the bigger picture it tells.

Responsibilities

  • Own core pieces of Plaid's top-line revenue forecast, building and refining the models and processes that turn what's happening in the business into an accurate, forward-looking number.

  • Go beyond the forecast itself to explain what's driving it: internal data and external market/macro factors that show how healthy and durable that growth is, while pushing the underlying process to be more automated and scalable over time.

  • Partner day-to-day with our GTM organization, turning forecasting and analytics work into insights that shape their planning and decisions.

  • Own recurring KPI and variance reporting cadences for key stakeholders (from day-to-day dashboards to quarterly Board materials), surfacing risks and opportunities early.

  • Help recruit and grow a strong Strategic Finance team at Plaid.

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or FP&A/strategic finance, ideally including time at a high-growth technology company.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical mindset, with the data fluency to work directly with large datasets (via SQL, AI tools, or both) and the judgment to build and validate financial models and workflows using them.

  • Strong financial modeling, communication, and presentation skills.

  • Comfortable working through moderately complex, ambiguous problems, distilling them into structured frameworks and actionable insights, with good judgment about when to loop in a manager or teammate rather than push forward alone.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships and drive alignment on financial targets.

  • Proficiency with core financial and GTM systems; Pigment, Tableau, or similar FP&A/BI tool experience is a plus.

The Talent team partners with leaders across Plaid to build the teams that build our products. We are committed to thoughtful, candidate-first hiring processes and to scaling with intention.

Plaid is inherently a global business with a global mission, and as our first recruiting hire in Europe, you will help us achieve it by building best-in-class teams across the region. You will own full-cycle recruiting from sourcing to close, develop hiring strategies, and lead first-in-kind searches, all while delivering an excellent candidate experience. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role as our European presence expands. We're just getting started.

What you'll do

  • Lead full-cycle recruiting for Plaid's European business teams, including GTM, Engineering and G&A from sourcing to close.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers in Europe and the US to scale teams in the region.

  • Work with our existing team to build localized processes and implement best practices for hiring top talent.

  • Act as a talent consultant to hiring managers, advising on market conditions, hiring strategy, and fair, consistent interviewing.

  • Help us improve and scale a clear, respectful, and inclusive candidate experience for people from all backgrounds.

  • Use data to identify gaps in the funnel and recommend improvements, including which candidate communities we are reaching and which we are missing.

What excites us

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, in-house or agency.

  • Experience in a fast-growing, changing environment, ideally building or improving recruiting processes.

  • A candidate-first approach that balances speed, quality, and experience.

  • Clear, effective communication with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

  • Ownership, discretion with confidential information, and attention to detail.

  • Experience hiring across multiple European markets.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The GTM Technology team sits within GTM Operations and owns the systems, architecture, and automation that power Plaid's go-to-market motion — Salesforce administration and platform architecture, quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash data integrity, and the evaluation and rollout of new GTM tooling, including AI and agentic tooling. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Engineering to make sure the systems behind revenue are accurate, scalable, and increasingly automated.

We're hiring a GTM Technology Engineer to help build and maintain the technical backbone of our GTM systems. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can write production-quality Salesforce code (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL), design clean integrations across our GTM stack (Salesforce, CPQ, contract lifecycle management, sales engagement, data warehouse, and more), and bring an AI-forward, builder mentality to how we automate and scale GTM Operations workflows.

You'll work on everything from diagnosing and fixing Apex logic that drives revenue-critical fields, to building integrations that connect Salesforce with adjacent platforms, to designing and deploying AI-powered agents and automations (using LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic workflows) that remove manual work from the GTM org. You'll report into GTM Technology and work alongside Salesforce architects, GTM Operations partners, and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Salesforce development: Design, build, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Flows that support core GTM processes.

  • Data integrity & diagnostics: Investigate and resolve issues in revenue-critical Apex services, tracing root causes across triggers, flows, and integration touchpoints.

  • Cross-platform integration: Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM stack (CPQ, CLM/contract tools, sales engagement platforms, data enrichment tools, data warehouse) using middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Tray.io), REST/SOAP APIs, and event-driven patterns.

  • AI & automation: Prototype and productionize AI-assisted workflows — using LLM APIs, Salesforce-hosted MCP servers, and agentic tooling — to automate manual RevOps processes (deal reviews, data QA, reporting, triage).

  • Platform architecture: Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions (data model, sharing model, integration patterns, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset) that keep the org scalable as Plaid's GTM motion grows.

  • Partnership: Work directly with RevOps, Deal Desk, Sales leadership, and Engineering to translate business requirements into reliable, well-tested technical solutions.

  • Quality & governance: Write testable, documented code; participate in code review and release management; support SOX/ITGC controls relevant to revenue systems where applicable.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience — Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL/SOSL, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP, platform events, middleware).

  • Experience with CPQ (Salesforce CPQ or similar) and a working understanding of quote-to-cash / lead-to-cash data flows.

  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, or LLM-backed automations that improve operational efficiency — building with AI tools, not just using them.

  • Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills — comfortable tracing a data issue from a Salesforce field back through Apex logic, automation, and upstream integrations.

  • Experience with integration/middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Tray.io, Workato, or similar) and modern API design.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), CI/CD, testing discipline, and code review practices.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills — comfortable working directly with GTM Operations, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance stakeholders to gather requirements and explain technical tradeoffs.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a proactive, builder-oriented mindset.

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect) are a plus but not required.

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

You will serve as a thought partner, contract expert, and at times, lead negotiator for major deals. Your work is thoroughly impactful as you will define the commercial terms that underpin the relationships between Plaid and its customers. You're motivated by tangible outcomes and finding win-win deals to strike with customers.

You'll also be a key partner to the broader set of Plaid’s go-to-market teams. You will help craft repeatable, robust commercial processes for an increasingly global team, leading to more speed and consistency. You enjoy rolling up your sleeves and diving into data analysis to make more educated decisions. You're keen on transparency and visibility to enable sharper decision-making and organizational communication.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with Plaid’s Sales, Account Management, and Enterprise teams to negotiate key customer contracts

  • Creatively enable new deals with top prospects while staying true to Plaid’s operating practices

  • Drive successful renewals, upsells, and cross-sells with top customers to increase usage and adoption of key Plaid products

  • Craft pricing strategies that work for Plaid, prospects, and existing customers

  • Evolve and improve commercial terms, practices, and processes

  • Serve as the GTM expert on a given GBT with regard to commercialization, pricing, and agreement requirements for new products and services

  • Serve as the GTM voice and single point of contact for cross-functional special projects

Qualifications

  • 4-7 years of experience in strategic sales, business development, finance/consulting, partnerships or GTM strategy—ideally with customer-facing ownership of complex, high-value commercial agreements.

  • Proven track record of negotiating complex deals, including multi-product or multi-party agreements in regulated industries such as financial services or fintech.

  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Engineering, and GTM teams to shape deals, align priorities, and unblock high-stakes internal initiatives.

  • Strong executive communication skills to confidently engage senior external stakeholders.

  • Experience building scalable commercial frameworks (e.g., pricing strategies, decision processes) that support speed and consistency across a growing GTM org.

  • Deep interest in fintech, open finance, and technical products, with the ability to understand and advocate for product capabilities in commercial conversations.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and change, with a bias for action and a growth mindset suited to fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Pinpoint and secure commercial partnerships with rapidly scaling organisations throughout Europe.

  • Manage the complete end-to-end sales motion, from initial prospecting and qualification through to final contract execution and handover.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional colleagues – including Account Management, Sales Engineering, Risk, and Product – to execute complex transactions.

  • Champion Plaid's mission and value proposition across the broader fintech landscape and adjacent sectors.

  • Help refine and scale our mid-market go-to-market playbooks and operational standards in a fast-growing region.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of end-to-end sales experience in quota-carrying, closing roles.

  • A track record of engaging product, engineering, and executive leaders.

jobs.title: Named Enterprise Account Executive- Mortgage
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

In this role, you will lead Plaid’s relationships with a focused group of leading mortgage lenders, servicers, and ecosystem partners, bringing the full breadth of Plaid’s offerings to the way they originate, verify, and underwrite loans. You will drive new business and expansion by running a disciplined, consultative sales process, uncovering high-value use cases, and building credibility with senior decision-makers, partnering with Product, Account Management, and other Go-To-Market colleagues to show customers measurable results. This role is ideal for a self-motivated seller who takes initiative, plans several moves ahead, and brings a collaborative, customer-first mindset to fellow sellers and cross-functional partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Own a named book of approximately 50 enterprise mortgage accounts, spanning national non-bank originators and servicers, top-tier and regional banks, credit unions, builder-affiliated lenders, and digital and home equity lenders

  • Serve as the core Plaid representative for your accounts, selling the full Plaid product portfolio across the mortgage vertical

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, for enterprise mortgage accounts

  • Coordinate with product sales specialists and other account pod members to bring the right expertise to each opportunity

  • Build executive relationships and identify the business value and impact of Plaid across your named accounts

  • Apply a deep understanding of the mortgage landscape, including the end-to-end mortgage workflow, mortgage technology, and the key partnerships needed to win deals

  • Articulate Plaid’s business value and technology advantage in the mortgage vertical to lenders, servicers, and ecosystem partners

  • Win as a team in partnership with your SDR, account manager, technical account manager, implementation manager, product organization, and other members of your account pod

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying experience in a new-revenue role, with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota and a strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals, including 5+ years focused on large enterprise customers

  • Ability to sell a technical solution to a business buyer, developing and delivering the value story at the executive level (experience selling APIs or other developer-oriented products a major plus)

  • Superior communication skills, including the ability to run compelling discovery conversations, present business cases to executive audiences, and keep internal partners aligned across long, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Strong prospecting, qualifying, and negotiating skills, with a consultative sales approach and a product-centric mindset

  • Working knowledge of the mortgage ecosystem and existing relationships with lenders, servicers, or mortgage technology providers

  • Experience selling a broad, multi-product portfolio and working effectively with specialist or overlay resources

  • Enthusiasm for working in a high-growth environment and helping build processes and tools as needed

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Network Health
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid’s Network Health team protects Plaid and our network from fraud and abuse. We build robust, intelligent yet flexible risk platforms and services to empower risk detection, mitigation, and resolution across all Plaid products and applications.

As Engineering Manager for Network Health, you will lead a growing, deeply technical team responsible for risk engineering at Plaid. You will set the long-term strategy and roadmap, translate evolving fraud scenarios and business requirements into technical priorities, and drive execution with a high technical bar. You will manage and grow software engineers, partner closely with embedded data scientists and machine learning engineers, and work hands-on with the data to identify trends and opportunities. This role is well suited to a high-agency leader who thrives in ambiguity and wants to remain close to the work while shaping a critical new team.

Responsibilities:

  • You’ll lead a team of 5 engineers and 2 embedded data scientists, developing them through clear goal setting, coaching, and feedback.

  • You’ll drive the long-term Network Health strategy and roadmap, in close partnership with technical and product leaders across Plaid

  • You’ll uphold a high bar for technical quality and delivery velocity, leading by example.

  • You’ll dive hands-on into the data and tech stack to understand current metrics, trends, and opportunities - then use those to guide the team’s technical decisions.

Nice to have:

  • 8+ years of industry experience, that includes time as a Staff-level engineer before transitioning into management.

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience

  • A track record of setting strategy and executing against roadmaps in ambiguous environments while navigating business, product, and technical tradeoffs.

  • Deep technical judgment in backend and data-intensive systems, with the ability to engage directly in architecture, system design, coding, and data analysis.

  • Experience in risk engineering, fraud detection, abuse prevention, trust and safety, or a related domain.

  • Track record of building and growing high performing engineering teams

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. You will partner closely with Product to shape product-market fit, influence roadmap decisions, and bring the voice of the customer into product strategy. You will partner across Sales, Enablement, Growth, and Marketing to translate the onboarding strategy into GTM programs that drive adoption and growth.

  • Lead onboarding positioning and messaging across products, ensuring a unified narrative.

  • Identify and validate product-market fit through customer insight, data, and experimentation.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Marketing to launch and scale products.

  • Influence roadmap decisions by advocating for customer needs and market signals.

  • 5+ years in Product Marketing, preferably in fintech or b2b technology.

jobs.title: Account Executive - This Week in Fintech
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

This Week in Fintech is the largest global fintech media company with 200,000+ subscribers to a publication that provides insights, news, and connections within the financial technology ecosystem. What began as a newsletter focused on curating and sharing industry updates, trends, and innovations in the fintech space has grown to include a range of products including podcasts, events, conferences, and an online community to bring together fintech professionals, investors, and enthusiasts worldwide.

This Week in Fintech is looking for an Account Executive with experience in advertising and media sales and is eager to build and grow their own book of business by selling across our diverse media offerings (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, events, and sponsored content).

In this role you’ll be a frontline ambassador for the brand, including; opening doors, pitching creative solutions, and building long-term partnerships with some of the most influential names in fintech, crypto, finance, venture capital, and beyond.

Responsibilties

  • P&L Ownership: Build and manage a complete sales pipeline, from prospecting and pitching to closing deals and managing post-sale client relationships to drive recurring revenue.

  • Strategic Selling: Develop and present compelling advertising solutions and media packages tailored to meet the marketing objectives of prospective clients.

  • Market Expertise: Become an expert on our audience data, media products, and the competitive landscape to effectively position This Week in Fintech as the premier media partner in the industry.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the content and operations teams to ensure smooth execution of client campaigns and deliver maximum value to our sponsors.

  • Startup Mindset: Embrace a fast-paced environment and contribute to the overall growth strategy of the company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3+ years of successful experience in advertising sales, media sales, or sponsorship sales.

  • Relationship Builder: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with a track record of building lasting client relationships.

  • Media Knowledge: Deep understanding of the media landscape, including digital advertising, content marketing, and sponsorship best practices.

  • Fintech or Financial Institution Knowledge: experience selling into fintechs or financial institutions and/or an existing book of business in this space.

  • HubSpot expertise

  • Location: Must be based in New York City.

postalAddress.streetAddress: 25 Worship Street, Plaid c/o TechSpace - 4th floor

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Client Engineering is the technical arm of Plaid’s European GTM team. We own our customers’ technical outcomes: designing the right solution, getting it built and live, and keeping it healthy as they grow. We work with the most technically forward companies in European financial services – fintechs, lenders, and payments and wealth platforms – helping them build on payment initiation, account data, verification, and underwriting across UK Open Banking and PSD2.

As a Sales Engineer for Plaid Europe, you’ll be a technical lead across the region’s sales team, partnering with 5–6 Account Executives from the first technical conversation through proof of concept to signature. You’ll run technical discovery, design solutions, and demo and prove Plaid’s products to engineers and commercial buyers, making sure every customer’s architectural decisions set them up for long-term success on the platform. You’ll also help build the Sales Engineering function in Europe, from the demo environments, sample apps, discovery frameworks, and integration playbooks the team sells with, to feeding what you hear from customers back into Plaid’s roadmap.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as technical lead on active opportunities across Startup, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, partnering with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle.

  • Run technical discovery and map customer requirements to Plaid’s products and integration patterns.

  • Deliver tailored demonstrations and own proof-of-concept engagements, including hands-on debugging with customer engineers.

  • Design integration architectures and validate the approach in sandbox with the customer’s engineers before signature.

  • Respond to technical, security, and regulatory questionnaires and RFPs.

  • Build and maintain reusable selling assets for European use cases and competitive positioning.

  • Translate customer and prospect feedback into structured product insight for Product and Engineering.

  • Raise the technical fluency of the sales team through enablement and deal reviews.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as sales engineering, solutions, implementation, or customer engineering, ideally at an API platform.

  • Hands-on understanding of APIs and web and mobile integration, including REST, OAuth, webhooks, JSON, and SDKs, with the ability to build and debug a demo in JavaScript, Python, or similar.

  • Experience working in, or selling to, fintech or financial services in the UK or EU.

  • Ability to move between deep technical conversations and business value conversations with different audiences.

  • A consultative approach, strong customer empathy, and clear communication skills.

  • A self-starter who’s comfortable building in a growing region with a globally distributed team.

  • Willingness and ability to travel across the UK and Europe up to 25% of the time.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP.

  • Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting.

  • A formal technical background or prior software engineering experience.

  • Fluency in a second European language.

You’ll write the integration plan, run the kickoff, debug alongside the customer’s engineers, validate their sandbox implementation, and see them through go-live, keeping their Account Manager up to date with notes that make the relationship easy to continue. You’ll do the same for existing customers adding a new product, use case, or market. You’ll also build the resources that make the next integration faster – the checklists, the common pitfalls, and the answers to the questions every customer asks – because this team is small and its leverage comes from what gets written down.

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of customer integrations from signature to production launch, including plans, milestones, and exit criteria.

  • Run scheduled implementation support for standard integrations, as well as one-off debugging engagements for customers who need a targeted fix.

  • Lead technical onboarding for existing customers adopting a new Plaid product, use case, or market.

  • Debug integration issues hands-on with customer engineers across API, SDK, OAuth redirect, and webhook behaviour.

  • Validate sandbox implementations and run go-live readiness checks.

  • Use Plaid’s own data to proactively diagnose integration and conversion problems.

  • Produce written handovers to Account Management and maintain the team’s reusable implementation resources.

  • Escalate recurring integration failures to Product and Engineering as clear patterns, backed by evidence.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as implementation, integration, solutions, or technical account management, ideally at an API platform.

  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, JSON, and web and mobile SDKs.

  • Comfort working in Postman or curl and reading API documentation critically.

  • Experience with SQL or other data querying tools.

  • A track record of owning technical projects end to end, with real deadlines and direct relationships with customer engineers.

  • Clear written communication skills, including plans, handovers, and customer updates.

  • Comfort working independently in a small regional team alongside a globally distributed function.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP.

  • Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting.

  • A formal technical background or prior software engineering experience.

  • Experience with mobile integrations.

We work with the most technically forward companies in European financial services – fintechs, lenders, and payments and wealth platforms – helping them build on payment initiation, account data, verification, and underwriting across UK Open Banking and PSD2.

As an Implementation Engineer for Plaid Europe, you’ll own customer integrations from the moment a contract is signed to the moment they’re live in production and growing. You’ll write the integration plan, run the kickoff, debug alongside the customer’s engineers, validate their sandbox implementation, and see them through go-live, keeping their Account Manager up to date with notes that make the relationship easy to continue. You’ll do the same for existing customers adding a new product, use case, or market. You’ll also build the resources that make the next integration faster – the checklists, the common pitfalls, and the answers to the questions every customer asks – because this team is small and its leverage comes from what gets written down.

 - Own a portfolio of customer integrations from signature to production launch, including plans, milestones, and exit criteria.

 - Validate sandbox implementations and run go-live readiness checks.

 - Use Plaid’s own data to proactively diagnose integration and conversion problems.

 - Produce written handovers to Account Management and maintain the team’s reusable implementation resources.

We play a crucial role in a customer's success by providing proactive strategic and technical guidance, which enables growth, expansion, and deeper customer relationships. Our goal is to ensure every customer becomes a lifelong Plaid champion and advocate.

This is a strategic, high-impact technical leadership position. You’ll own the long-term technical success of some of the most innovative Enterprise companies in the world, influencing how millions of users experience financial connectivity. You will be a product expert in Plaid's offerings, owning many customer relationships simultaneously and stay up to date on Plaid's technological improvements and new product offerings. You’ll be the technical voice and advocate for your customers internally, helping to shape Plaid’s product direction based on real-world feedback and impact. You will work in partnership with Account Managers and several other cross-functional teams to be the primary driver of the design and execution of technical strategies that help our customers achieve their goals.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Plaid's most strategic Enterprise customers as their technical expert, helping them use Plaid to meet their business and technical goals

  • Own the post-sales technical strategy and alignment with customers, ensuring our mutual roadmaps are understood and communicated

  • Proactively identify opportunities to optimize customer integrations and drive adoption of Plaid's newest technical features, tying each to measurable outcomes such as increased conversion, error reduction, or expanded coverage

  • Build and maintain relationships with technical stakeholders at every level, from engineers to CPOs and CTOs

  • Advocate for customers by translating their feedback into product insights for internal teams, and partner with key stakeholders to align their business and product priorities with Plaid's

  • Serve as the escalation point for technical incidents or issues that surface beyond normal Plaid support channels

  • Collaborate with account managers to define, track, and deliver quarterly technical account goals that grow product adoption and customer value

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in client-facing, technology-focused roles that combine business expertise and technical acumen; experience working with enterprise customers strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex customer relationships and develop technical strategies that drive adoption, customer success, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong technical foundation across APIs, databases, system infrastructure, and architecture; experience with tools such as Postman, SQL, and monitoring/logging platforms is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences and connect solutions to business objectives, KPIs, and revenue outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and influence technical decision-makers and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • Proactive, customer-first problem solver with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity, escalations, competing priorities, and unexpected roadblocks under pressure.

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The mission of Plaid's Product Security Team is “Improve our customer’s trust by assuring secure development and delivery of products and services, minimizing risk to the ecosystem, and preventing security incidents."

Plaid's Product Security team helps engineering teams build secure products and continuously identify and reduce security risks. Our work spans security architecture and design, application security, vulnerability management, supply chain security, and security automation.

We work directly with product and engineering teams to identify risks early, influence secure architecture, and define security requirements. We build and leverage automated security capabilities to expand testing coverage, validate fixes, and reduce recurring vulnerabilities. As AI accelerates software development, our goal is to help Plaid maintain strong security without relying on manual reviews for every change.

This role is perfect for you if:

  • You enjoy understanding complex products and systems and finding security risks that are not immediately obvious.

  • You have strong application security fundamentals and are comfortable working directly with code and architecture.

  • You enjoy working closely with engineers and product teams to solve security problems early in development.

  • You can evaluate technical and business tradeoffs and influence architectural decisions.

  • You are excited about how AI is changing software development and how we approach product security.

About the role:

  • Lead security architecture and design reviews for high-priority Plaid products, working directly with engineering and product teams from early development through launch.

  • Conduct threat modeling and technical security assessments of complex applications, APIs, distributed systems, and product workflows to identify material security risks.

  • Evaluate authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, sensitive data flows, and business logic to identify potential vulnerabilities and abuse cases.

  • Review application code, investigate security weaknesses, and validate that proposed fixes address the underlying risks.

  • Assess security implications of new technologies and product capabilities, including AI-powered applications and agentic workflows.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to prioritize material security risks, agree on mitigations, and track them through remediation or approved risk acceptance.

  • Identify recurring security weaknesses, define reusable security requirements and secure design patterns, and partner with engineering teams to implement preventive controls.

  • Leverage AI-assisted security analysis and testing to continuously improve security assessments and validate important security assumptions.

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in product or application security, with strong expertise in secure architecture, application security fundamentals, and technical risk assessment.

  • Experience leading security design reviews and threat modeling for complex applications, APIs, or distributed systems.

  • Deep understanding of authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, sensitive data protection, and common application security vulnerabilities.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to read application code, analyze vulnerability paths, and evaluate security fixes.

  • Experience assessing security risks in cloud-native applications and understanding the security implications of system architecture and implementation decisions.

  • Ability to communicate complex security risks, recommend practical mitigations, and influence engineering and product leadership.

  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and collaborate effectively across teams.

Nice to have:

  • Experience securing AI-powered applications or agentic systems.

  • Experience with penetration testing, vulnerability research, or security testing of complex business logic.

  • Experience securing financial technology products or systems handling sensitive or regulated data.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Plaid’s Executive Assistant (EA) team sits within the People Team and partners closely with the company’s most senior leaders. Our EAs are trusted, strategic partners who help leaders stay focused on their highest-impact work—from managing complex calendars and preparing for critical meetings to coordinating Board logistics, leadership offsites, customer dinners, and company-wide events. We operate as one connected team, sharing best practices, supporting one another, and exploring new technology and AI-enabled approaches to make the way we work faster, smarter, and more effective.

As the EA Team Lead, you’ll lead and develop a team of EAs who support senior leaders across Plaid, while also directly supporting one of our C-Suite executives. You’ll set clear standards, bring consistency and best practices to high-impact areas such as leadership rhythms, onsite planning, and company events, and serve as a trusted partner to executives and People Team leaders. You’ll also help evolve and scale the function through new approaches to technology, AI, and automation.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of EAs through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, goal setting, and career development.

  • Provide direct support for one C-Suite Executive and back up coverage as needed.

  • Set the vision and operating standards for the EA program, including onboarding, role expectations, coverage, and ways of working.

  • Build scalable playbooks, templates, and repeatable approaches for leadership meetings, onsite planning, All Hands, company events, and other high-impact programs.

  • Foster a connected EA community through shared practices, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful coverage across the team.

  • Partner with executives and their EAs to understand priorities, calibrate support, and ensure the right level of coverage.

  • Own hiring for the EA team, including defining the bar, partnering with Recruiting, and onboarding new hires.

  • Identify and implement efficiencies through technology, AI, and automation to improve how the team works.

  • Serve as an escalation point and thought partner for complex, sensitive, or cross-functional situations.

  • Partner with the People Team on programs and initiatives involving executive and leadership support.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as an EA supporting C-suite executives in complex, fast-paced environments.

  • 3-5 years of experience leading, coaching, or managing EAs or administrative teams.

  • A track record of developing people, with the ability to give clear, direct feedback and help others grow.

  • Experience planning and running complex programs and events, such as leadership onsites, Board meetings, All Hands, and company events.

  • A strategic and operational mindset, with the ability to turn recurring work into scalable, repeatable systems.

  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information.

  • Ability to build trust and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners without relying on authority.

  • Builder mindset, with comfort using technology, AI, and automation to improve how work gets done.

Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As a New Business Leader, you will oversee a team of New Business Representatives (NBRs) and New Business Account Executives (NBAEs), leading team performance to deliver business needs and building world-class talent.

In this role, you will:

  • Oversee a team of 8 new business representatives: You will be responsible for managing them to hit their quota and other key metrics.

  • Lead team performance to deliver business needs: Partner closely with Marketing and Sales leadership to ensure we generate pipeline to the appropriate level and quality to hit business targets.

  • Recruit, build, and nurture a high-performance team: Identify strong sales talent, onboard them, and coach them to develop professionally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Management: Manage a high-performing team of New Business Representatives to hit and exceed quota.

  • Pipeline Development & Management: Ensure pipeline generation meets business targets; partner with Marketing and Sales leadership to unlock and unblock pipeline creation.

  • Coaching & Mentorship: Actively coach team members to develop their sales acumen, prospecting techniques, and career trajectories.

  • Team Building: Hire, develop, and promote world-class talent through continuous evergreen recruiting efforts.

  • Strategy & Innovation: Drive step-change improvements across the function, including MQL conversion rates, cadence optimizations, and targeting high-intent leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Quantitative Inclination: Strong comfort with and passion for delivering against quantitative targets and metrics.

jobs.title: Associate Account Executive Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Plaid is building our first-ever inside sales team of Associate Account Executives, and looking for a strong Sales Leader to build this critical function from the ground up. Our upmarket business is driving Plaid’s growth as we expand across new verticals and accelerate in target growth areas across credit, payments and fraud. Associate Account Executives fuel this growth by helping us scale in key industries. They partner with strategic, senior sellers to generate new pipeline, advance complex opportunities from initial outbound through close, and extend the AE’s reach through onsite engagement, industry events, and day-to-day customer interactions.

As the founding leader of the function, you’ll build and define how the team operates, shape its playbooks and development model, and build a high-performing group of early- to mid-career sellers. You’ll be close to the work: coaching reps in real time, joining customer conversations, building repeatable ways of working, and building scalable motions. This is an ideal role for a sales leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, gets energy from developing talent, and wants to directly shape how Plaid grows revenue across Enterprise. This role reports to the Head of Enterprise Sales.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of 8-10 Account Executives, driving pipeline development and deal strategy

  • Coach AEs with hands-on guidance across discovery, pricing, objection handling, and full-cycle deal execution

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent, and design the ramp and performance bar for the team

  • Scale the team playbook across product areas and verticals, including discovery frameworks, business-case and ROI models, mutual action plans, objection-handling guides, and competitive positioning

  • Run the operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection, and forecast calls to improve pipeline creation, conversion, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop vertical strategy, messaging, and account scale plans

  • Work with GTM leadership on KPIs, CRM hygiene, capacity planning and forecasting, messaging, targeting, and revenue targets

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a high-growth environment

  • 2+ years in a sales leadership or team lead role

  • A track record as a top-performing, quota-carrying seller in complex, multi-persona sales motions

  • Experience selling to, or leading sellers who sell to, financial institutions, fintechs, or enterprise accounts

  • Ability to bring clarity and process across two segments with different stakeholders and sales cycles

  • Strong organization, a data-driven approach, and comfort operating in a rapidly evolving environment

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Risk, Legal, and Solutions Engineering

  • Passion for developing talent and building a top-tier early-career sales bench

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. Sales Engineering unlocks the full potential of the Plaid Network. We combine deep product expertise with a customer-obsessed approach to serve as trusted technical advisors throughout the pre-sales process and help customers realize business value.

As Plaid’s first dedicated Sales Engineer for Regulated Industries, you will partner with Enterprise Account Executives as their technical lead and build this function from the ground up across Public Sector, Education, Healthcare and Life Sciences, and Utilities. You will help customers and ecosystem partners translate Plaid’s solutions into real-world use cases across payments, identity, fraud, onboarding, and income verification. You will also collaborate closely with other cross-functional teams to define the playbooks and go-to-market motions that will drive growth in these markets.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead technical advisor from discovery through solution design, evaluation, technical win, and post-sale handoff.

  • Partner with AEs to connect technical capabilities to business value across regulated industries.

  • Lead discovery, demos, architecture design, and RFIs/RFPs for payments, account verification, onboarding, income, and fraud workflows.

  • Run hands-on API pilots and POCs, defining success criteria, diagnosing gaps, and guiding integration tradeoffs.

  • Surface product, privacy, security, and compliance requirements early and coordinate appropriate specialist reviews.

  • Build reusable solution guides, reference architectures, and enablement that support partner integrations and downstream adoption.

  • Shape vertical strategy and product feedback with Sales, Product, Partnerships, and Marketing.

  • Partner with Implementation and the broader SE team on successful handoffs, adoption, and shared best practices.

  • 3+ years supporting one or more regulated industries, including Public Sector, Healthcare, Education, Utilities, or similarly regulated environments.

  • Nice to have: fintech/payments, identity, fraud, or income-verification experience; familiarity with public-sector procurement, systems integrators, or healthcare platforms such as RCM and EHR systems.

  • Experience leading complex technical evaluations and partnering strategically with AEs across multistakeholder pursuits.

  • Hands-on API and web/mobile architecture knowledge; ability to build demos, solution diagrams, and integration guidance.

  • Strong discovery, communication, and customer empathy, connecting technical choices to business outcomes.

  • Ability to learn new sectors, navigate ambiguity, and validate product-market fit.

  • Sound judgment working with Product, Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Security, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Ability to build reusable technical assets and support partner-led integrations and adoption.

  • Willing and able to travel up to 25% of the time.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Office of the CEO
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid’s Executive Assistant (EA) team sits within the People Team and partners closely with the company’s senior leaders, including our CEO and Executive Staff. Our EAs are trusted, strategic partners who help leaders stay focused on their highest-impact work—from managing complex calendars and preparing for critical meetings to coordinating Board logistics, leadership onsites, customer dinners, and company-wide events. We operate as one connected team, sharing best practices, supporting one another, and exploring process redesign, new technology and AI-enabled approaches to make the way we work faster, smarter, and more effective.

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you’ll partner directly with Zach Perret, our CEO and Co-Founder. You’ll own Zach’s calendar and operating rhythm, and manage the logistics around leadership—from Board meetings and Staff offsites to customer dinners and Product team events. You’ll learn how he thinks and works, tailor your support accordingly, and evolve how you operate together through new approaches to technology and AI. You’ll join our EA team within the People Team, reporting to the EA Team Lead and working alongside fellow EAs and cross-functional partners.

Responsibilities

  • Own Zach's calendar end-to-end, aligning his time with company priorities, protecting focus and recovery, and shaping incoming requests.

  • Build the systems that keep Zach running smoothly, including travel, expenses, task tracking, and day-to-day logistics, in coordination with his broader support network.

  • Manage logistics of company leadership, from Staff team on-sites to Board and Committee meetings, and organize customer dinners and other external engagements.

  • Zach also runs the Product team, you'll coordinate Product team meetings, agendas, on-sites, and events to help the team operate at a high level.

  • Own special projects end to end using AI and automation to find better ways of working

  • Share best practices with fellow EAs and provide coverage when needed.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with 4+ years of experience as an EA supporting C-suite executives in fast-paced environments

  • 2+ years supporting a CEO

  • A forward-leaning, results-oriented approach to problem-solving with a bias to action

  • High agency and creativity, with a builder mentality

  • An automation mindset and a drive to find better ways of working

  • Openness to feedback and resilience

  • Comfort with a high pace of change and working at a very fast pace

  • Willingness to work flexible hours when needed

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Consumer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Plaid Link is the front door to modern financial experiences. It securely connects people’s financial accounts to the apps and services they trust, and it’s the foundation Plaid’s product teams build onboarding, payments, identity, and lending experiences on. Link supports more than 12,000 financial institutions and 9,000+ apps and services, is used by roughly one in two adults with a bank account, and is the starting point for approximately 750,000 connections every day.

The Unified Link team is now focused on building a single onboarding platform for Plaid’s products. Customers will integrate once through a single API and turn on additional products with a toggle in the dashboard, making it easy to adopt new capabilities and expand their use of Plaid.

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead roughly ten engineers through a major transformation: bringing our existing onboarding products together, moving Link’s highest-traffic experiences onto the new foundation without disrupting the traffic they carry every day, and continuing to improve the Link experience along the way. You’ll partner closely with a Principle Engineer and the team’s Tech Lead to set technical direction and sequence the migration, and with Product, Design, and teams across Plaid to make the platform easy to adopt and extend. All while maintaining a high bar for quality and reliability, and growing your engineers through clear priorities, coaching, and feedback.

Responsibilities

  • Set team strategy and the technical roadmap in partnership with the Tech Lead, balancing the platform migration with ongoing improvements to Link

  • Drive team execution (planning, sprints, delivery) and hold a high technical bar through hands-on involvement in design and code review

  • Hire, manage, and develop a team of engineers, including goal setting, coaching, feedback, and performance management

  • Partner with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Plaid to define clear interfaces and make the unified platform easy to adopt and extend

  • Keep Link reliable and healthy through the transition, making sound tradeoffs between new work and long-term system health

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as a backend or full-stack engineer, with a track record of designing and shipping complex, scalable systems

  • 2+ years managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and building a team

  • Strong technical depth: you can dive into architecture and design details, and credibly hold a high bar for the team

  • Strong user empathy and the ability to balance technical tradeoffs with product outcomes

  • Nice to have: experience building consumer-facing products and/or product led growth (PLG) dev tools

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. You'll own end-to-end messaging and positioning for the Credit product area, develop the ICPs and customer insights that inform both product and sales strategy, and build the enablement materials that give our GTM team what they need to win. You'll partner closely with Product, Revenue, and Marketing to make sure Credit's story is clear, differentiated, and landing in the field.

Responsibilities

  • Product-Market Fit: Independently own market signal gathering for the Credit product area — synthesizing customer feedback, competitive intelligence, pricing signals, and TAM analysis. Lead ICP development and maintenance. Steward Credit products through Alpha and Beta, including owning the design partner process. Provide data-driven recommendations on feature set, architecture, and pricing to the product team, and actively represent customer needs in roadmap reviews.

  • Customer Comprehension and Advocacy: Independently develop and maintain ICPs for the Credit product area. Lead customer discovery and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into action. Define audience targeting for Credit use cases. Consistently surface customer themes in partnership with Credit GTM to Product and drive advocacy with evidence.

  • Messaging and Positioning: Own messaging and positioning for the Credit product area end-to-end. Develop compelling narrative hierarchies from value prop to full story. Validate messaging through experimentation, research, and field testing. Iterate based on product changes, competitive shifts, and GTM performance. Partner with other PMMs on Credit-relevant use case and cross-product messaging.

  • GTM Strategy and Execution: Create and drive GTM strategy and launch plans for Credit products. Set goals for GTM programs and track adoption and funnel metrics. Develop integrated campaign strategies with channel owners across marketing. Proactively identify and resolve obstacles to GTM execution.

  • Sales and GTM Enablement: Independently own all GTM and sales enablement for the Credit product area. Ensure collateral is easy to find, up to date, and reliable across all channels. Lead enablement sessions tailored to audience and sales stage. Gather sales feedback systematically and incorporate into future materials. Proactively identify and close enablement gaps without being asked.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience with 5+ years in product marketing or other strategic GTM role at a B2B software company. Credit/Lending experience strongly preferred.

  • Outstanding written, storytelling and visual communication skills – comfortable developing marketing and sales content that resonates with lenders.

  • Exceptional ability to conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns

  • Desire to engage deeply with cross-functional partners across Revenue, Marketing, Product, Design, Engineering – and build an in-depth understanding of how our solutions work and deliver customers value.

  • Strong presence and verbal communicator

jobs.title: Economist, Macro & Economic Insights
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Economics Team uses economic research and data science to deepen our understanding of economic, credit, and financial trends. We combine rigorous empirical analysis with clear communication to inform decisions across and beyond Plaid.

You will conduct applied economic research, develop reliable analytical methods, and turn complex findings into clear, useful insights. Working with economists and data scientists, you will own research projects from question framing and data preparation through validation and written communication. This is a hands-on role for an economist who enjoys working with large datasets, exercising sound judgment, and explaining evidence and limitations to a range of audiences. You will have opportunities to develop a research specialty and take on broader ownership as the team grows.

We're guided by our principles including impact, growing together, embracing openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow; we're looking for leaders who are motivated by those same principles

Responsibilities

  • Investigating economic questions and trends through rigorous empirical research, from framing the question through analysis, validation, and communication

  • Working with large, complex datasets to develop reliable measures and reproducible analytical workflows

  • Evaluating findings against established research and public benchmarks, assessing data quality and representativeness, and clearly communicating uncertainty and limitations

  • Applying econometric and time-series methods to test hypotheses, assess robustness, and distinguish meaningful patterns from noise

  • Writing clear research briefs and presenting findings to technical and nontechnical audiences; partnering with colleagues across research, data science, and the business to identify useful questions and inform decisions

Qualifications

  • PhD in economics or a related empirical field, or a Master's plus 4+ years of relevant applied experience, with strong empirical training. Exceptional candidates completing their PhD in 2027 are welcome; relevant research includes applied macroeconomics, household or behavioral finance, fintech, and financial regulation

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience independently analyzing large, complex datasets and building reproducible analytical workflows

  • Strong econometric and time-series modeling skills, with experience applying these methods to economic questions and assessing robustness

  • Excellent writing for non-academic audiences, demonstrated through policy memos, market commentary, or research briefs. You can explain and defend your methods, findings, and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences

  • Sound research judgment: you distinguish evidence from interpretation, communicate uncertainty, and scope claims to what the data supports

  • Nice to have: experience conducting applied economic research in fintech, finance, a research institute, or a public-sector organization; prior ownership of a recurring research publication

jobs.title: Inside Sales Leader
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Plaid is building our first-ever inside sales team of Associate Account Executives, and looking for a strong Sales Leader to build this critical function from the ground up. Our upmarket business is driving Plaid’s growth as we expand across new verticals and accelerate in target growth areas across credit, payments and fraud. Associate Account Executives fuel this growth by helping us scale in key industries. They partner with strategic, senior sellers to generate new pipeline, advance complex opportunities from initial outbound through close, and extend the AE’s reach through onsite engagement, industry events, and day-to-day customer interactions.

As the founding leader of the function, you’ll build and define how the team operates, shape its playbooks and development model, and build a high-performing group of early- to mid-career sellers. You’ll be close to the work: coaching reps in real time, joining customer conversations, building repeatable ways of working, and building scalable motions. This is an ideal role for a sales leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, gets energy from developing talent, and wants to directly shape how Plaid grows revenue across Enterprise. This role reports to the Head of Enterprise Sales.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of 8-10 Account Executives, driving pipeline development and deal strategy

  • Coach AEs with hands-on guidance across discovery, pricing, objection handling, and full-cycle deal execution

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent, and design the ramp and performance bar for the team

  • Scale the team playbook across product areas and verticals, including discovery frameworks, business-case and ROI models, mutual action plans, objection-handling guides, and competitive positioning

  • Run the operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection, and forecast calls to improve pipeline creation, conversion, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop vertical strategy, messaging, and account scale plans

  • Work with GTM leadership on KPIs, CRM hygiene, capacity planning and forecasting, messaging, targeting, and revenue targets

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a high-growth environment

  • 2+ years in a sales leadership or team lead role

  • A track record as a top-performing, quota-carrying seller in complex, multi-persona sales motions

  • Experience selling to, or leading sellers who sell to, financial institutions, fintechs, or enterprise accounts

  • Ability to bring clarity and process across two segments with different stakeholders and sales cycles

  • Strong organization, a data-driven approach, and comfort operating in a rapidly evolving environment

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Risk, Legal, and Solutions Engineering

  • Passion for developing talent and building a top-tier early-career sales bench

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Network Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As an Infrastructure Engineer on Network Infrastructure, you'll own large parts of the network that every Plaid product depends on. You'll plan and lead changes that touch the whole company, like upgrading our service mesh or modernizing older parts of our cloud network, and deliver them safely without disrupting customers. You'll build tools that let product engineers move faster on their own, help strengthen the security and compliance boundaries in our network, and dig into hard problems when something goes wrong. The team is small and new, so you'll have a real voice in its technical direction, with a clear path toward Staff-level scope.

Responsibilities

  • Lead company-wide network changes, such as service mesh upgrades and gateway migrations, using staged rollouts so customers see no disruption.

  • Simplify and modernize our cloud network, reducing risk and making it easier to operate.

  • Build self-serve tools in Go and Terraform that let product engineers expose, route and secure their services independently.

  • Help set stronger security and compliance boundaries in our network without slowing developers down.

  • Debug complex network issues and turn what you learn into better alerts, dashboards and guardrails.

  • Take part in on-call, lead incident response for network issues, and drive the follow-up fixes.

Qualifications

  • Experience running production infrastructure at scale, in infrastructure, SRE or network engineering

  • A solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP and load balancing

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking, such as a CNI, a service mesh or ingress

  • Experience with cloud networking, ideally on AWS

  • Ability to write code in Go or Python

  • A track record of making large production changes safely, with a plan for rollback

  • Nice-to-Have:

    • Production experience with Istio, Envoy or Cilium
