jobs.title: Security Compliance Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

Plaid’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team enables the business by proactively managing information security risk and maintaining effective controls. We partner across the company to keep Plaid’s platform secure, resilient, and aligned with industry and regulatory expectations.

Our assurance program builds trust with customers, consumers, and data partners. Core compliance is how we prove it. We run the certifications, audits, and regulatory obligations that let banks, customers, and regulators rely on Plaid, and we keep them aligned with a product that keeps changing.

About the role

As Security Compliance Lead, you’ll be the single accountable owner of Plaid’s core security compliance program: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and their governance obligations. Banks, enterprise customers, and regulators rely on what you own when they decide to work with Plaid, and your work keeps those certifications and commitments reliable and on time as the business grows.

You will set the program’s structure and direction, with a roadmap and KPIs that turn compliance from a pass/fail event into a program leadership can steer. The control catalog you build will sit behind every audit, so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy many obligations, from SOC 2 to FedRAMP. Your internal audits will find gaps before an external auditor, customer, or regulator does. You will make sure compliance shapes product decisions before launch instead of reacting to them.

As Plaid expands into new products, markets, and frameworks, you will build a program that keeps pace without adding headcount, using AI and automation.

Responsibilities

  • Own the compliance program and governance calendar: Lead SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 end to end. Run the annual and quarterly governance obligations (policy reviews, access and change-management reviews, security training, vendor reviews, and regulatory, bank, and partner assessments), each with an owner, a date, and evidence of completion.

  • Build and own the control catalog: Design and maintain one control catalog mapped across every framework Plaid reports against, built to FedRAMP and NIST 800-53 depth, with clear control owners, quarterly owner certification, and testing.

  • Run internal audit and policy assurance: Build a risk-based internal audit plan that tests operating effectiveness and whether policies are followed, and own the policy lifecycle. Track findings to remediation, and partner with Finance on ITGCs.

  • Set direction and measure the program: Define what a mature program looks like, set the roadmap and KPIs to get there, and report progress to security leadership each quarter.

  • Embed GRC by design: Track product roadmaps and supporting infrastructure with Product and Engineering. You will assess how launches and material changes affect audit scope and system boundaries, and build lightweight checkpoints into product discovery.

  • Scale through AI and automation: Build repeatable processes, runbooks, and AI-driven automation for evidence, testing, scoping, and audit requests.

Qualifications

Must haves:

  • Compliance program ownership:

    • Has been the accountable owner of SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001/27701 programs through multiple audit cycles, including setting the roadmap and KPIs that matured them

    • Has built or rebuilt a common control framework mapped across multiple frameworks, with control owners and testing

  • FedRAMP:

    • Hands-on FedRAMP experience (Rev5 or 20x): NIST 800-53 control implementation, boundary and SSP documentation, third-party assessment, and continuous monitoring

  • Internal audit, policy assurance, ITGC, and SOX:

    • Has planned and run risk-based internal audits that test operating effectiveness and policy adherence, and has driven findings to remediation

    • Has worked with Finance or internal controls teams and external auditors on ITGCs and SOX

  • Governance obligations and product-aware compliance:

    • Has partnered with Product and Engineering to scope launches and infrastructure changes into audits, and has embedded compliance checkpoints into product development

    • Has run a recurring governance calendar (policy, access, training, vendor, and regulatory or partner reviews) and translated obligations from customers, banks, regulators, or government agencies into control and audit requirements

  • AI fluency and tooling:

    • Takes an AI-first approach: has built AI workflows or automations that materially reduced manual compliance work, and shares what works with the team

Nice to have:

  • Experience with EU financial-services obligations (DORA, central bank IT and cyber assessments, FCA operational and security risk reporting) or bank-consortium assessments such as TruSight

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Credit (Retros)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.


About the Role

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

  • Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

  • Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.

  • Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.

  • Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.

  • Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.

  • Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.

  • Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.

  • Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.

  • Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.


What Excites You

  • Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.

  • Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.

  • Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.

  • Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.

  • Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.


What Excites Us

  • 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

  • Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.

  • Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.

  • Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.

  • Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.

  • Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

  • Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

About the Team

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We apply machine learning to high-impact product challenges, working across product areas to develop solutions that create meaningful customer value.

We focus on credit, building models to the standards required in lending and supporting the next wave of cash-flow-based underwriting. We value technical expertise, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork, and we’re guided by Plaid’s principles of impact, growing together, openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow.


About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Credit team, you’ll design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning solutions that support Income Insights and the future of cash-flow-based underwriting. You’ll work across the full model lifecycle—from experimentation and offline training through production serving and monitoring—and partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to turn data and new modeling approaches into reliable systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and productionize AI and machine learning models, from offline training through online serving and ongoing monitoring.

  • Experiment with modeling approaches and strategies for credit use cases, balancing model performance with the requirements of lending environments.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ingest signals and build the systems needed to bring models into production.

  • Contribute to both 0-to-1 problems and the scaling and improvement of established solutions.

  • Collaborate with teams across Plaid to help define the machine learning roadmap.

  • Dive into data and use evidence-based analysis to guide day-to-day decisions.

What Excites You

  • Building products that can empower millions of people through well-known and emerging fintech applications.

  • Experimenting with modern machine learning techniques on meaningful credit and lending problems.

  • Working across the full lifecycle of machine learning systems, from exploration to production and ongoing improvement.

  • Taking on both greenfield challenges and opportunities to scale solutions that are already delivering value.

  • Joining a high-ownership, bottom-up team where your work can shape the roadmap and drive business impact.

What Excites Us

  • 2+ years of experience training and serving AI or machine learning models in a production environment.

  • Experience in fintech lending and a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending.

  • Experience building or working with data-intensive backend applications in large, distributed systems.

  • Ability to code and iterate independently using data infrastructure tools such as Python, Spark, Jupyter notebooks, and standard machine learning libraries.

  • A track record of taking ownership and driving projects to business impact.

  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a closely related field.

  • Nice to have: Experience in data analytics or data engineering.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The People team’s goal is to make Plaid the highlight of every employee’s career. To do that, we’re rebuilding HR for an AI-first company. We want HR to be seamless, proactive, and personal at scale, so employees get support when they need it and the People team can spend its time on higher-value work.

As People Operations Manager, you’ll lead the team that runs onboarding, employee lifecycle changes, HR case management, compliance, and immigration, and you’ll redesign those processes for AI and automation. You’ll manage a team of three Operations specialists, including an Immigration Specialist, and report to the Head of People Technology, AI and Operations.


This is a hands-on role. You’ll map processes, configure workflows, and lead your team through change, working closely with People Systems, Finance, Tech Ops, and HR Business Partners.

Responsibilities

Redesign People Operations for an AI-first model

  • Define and own the multi-year People Operations strategy and roadmap, in line with our broader HR AI strategy.

  • Own the redesign of core processes (onboarding, job and pay changes, leave, offboarding, employment verification, and HR case handling) so AI and automation handle routine work and the team handles exceptions.

  • Partner with People Systems to expand what the AI assistant, ticketing, and knowledge management systems can resolve, and keep the knowledge base accurate.

  • Define and own team metrics, including self-service resolution rate, time to resolution, employee satisfaction, and HR capacity freed up.

  • Pilot new tools and workflows, and decide what to scale or stop.

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage and develop three direct reports.

  • Shift the team’s work from transaction processing to process design, quality control, and exception handling.

  • Build the team’s AI skills through hands-on use.

Run reliable, compliant operations

  • Own the accuracy and auditability of employee data and transactions in our HR systems.

  • Manage the Immigration Specialist who runs our U.S. immigration program, and provide high-level guidance on decisions, priorities, and compliance risk.

  • Support audits, policy administration, and regulatory requirements.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with Finance on payroll inputs, headcount changes, and reconciliations.

  • Partner with Tech Ops on access, equipment, and onboarding and offboarding handoffs.

  • Partner with HR Business Partners to turn recurring employee and manager issues into process fixes.

  • Represent the employee experience in decisions about HR tools and workflows.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in People Operations, including experience managing a People Operations team and setting People Operations strategy, ideally at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Experience implementing tools that improved People Operations efficiency, such as ticketing, a knowledge base, or workflow automation, with measurable results.

  • Ability to redesign processes from first principles for AI and automation, not just digitize existing steps.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with Workday and working familiarity with the wider People tech stack, including the ability to configure workflows, document processes, and work with data.

  • Track record of working with Finance, Tech Ops, People Technology, and HR Business Partners.

  • Clear communication, sound judgment on sensitive employee matters, and the ability to lead a team through change.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools at work, with judgment on which ones deliver real efficiency gains, is a plus.

  • Experience building automations, AI agents, or no-code workflows is a plus.

  • Familiarity with ticketing and knowledge management platforms and AI-enabled HR tools is a plus.

  • Experience managing a specialist or working with outside counsel on U.S. immigration matters is a plus.

  • Experience partnering with People Analytics or data teams on reporting and data quality is a plus.

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

We're looking for an experienced Go-to-Market (GTM) Recruiter who can drive full-cycle recruiting, build strong partnerships with business leaders, and help shape how we attract and hire top talent. You'll bring a consultative mindset, strong execution, and the ability to navigate competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What excites you:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across Plaid's GTM functions, from developing sourcing strategies and building pipelines to managing interviews and closing top talent.

  • Partner strategically with business leaders and hiring managers to understand organizational priorities, develop hiring strategies, and deliver against critical talent needs.

  • Drive recruiting excellence by leveraging market insights, data, and recruiting best practices to influence hiring decisions and improve outcomes.

  • Build and engage diverse talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, relationship building, and creative approaches to identifying exceptional candidates.

  • Champion a high hiring bar by providing thoughtful talent assessments, advising hiring teams, and driving consistent, effective hiring processes.

  • Elevate the candidate experience by ensuring every candidate has a thoughtful, transparent, and engaging experience throughout the hiring process.

  • Improve how we hire by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, increase efficiency, and scale recruiting practices as the business evolves.

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally supporting GTM or other corporate functions in a high-growth environment.

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex searches and deliver results across multiple roles and competing priorities.

  • Strong business partnership and influencing skills, with experience advising hiring managers and senior stakeholders on talent strategy, market dynamics, and hiring decisions.

  • A proactive, resourceful approach to sourcing and building high-quality talent pipelines in competitive markets.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to leverage recruiting metrics and market insights to identify challenges and drive improvements.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in concepting and executing across multiple mediums—from campaign development to social to video storyboards—and knows how to bring a big idea to life with consistency, creativity, and impeccable design execution. You’re a design generalist that can flex across any medium and thrives in the world of brand campaigns.

This role will report to the Creative Lead - Campaigns.

  • Work closely with content design and copywriters to iterate and bring ideas to life

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align on creative strategy, timelines, and production plans

  • Work closely with motion designers and editors on storyboards, motion graphics, and polished video content

  • Design a full suite of end-to-end marketing collateral, including ads, social assets, email, and print

  • Provide creative leadership and feedback across our broader design team, ensuring brand consistency and the highest bar for design craft

  • Communicate progress clearly and regularly, offering creative rationale with a strong and strategic point of view.

  • Animation and illustration skills a plus, but not required

The Role
We’re looking for a contract sourcer to join our Business recruiting team during a period of growth. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career who wants hands-on experience in a fast-growing fintech company.


What You’ll Do

  • Identify and research potential candidates for Business and GTM roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, boolean search, and other sourcing tools

  • Write personalized outreach and follow up with candidates by email and InMail

  • Partner with recruiters to build and maintain talent pipelines and keep candidates moving through the interview process

  • Conduct initial candidate screens to assess qualifications, relevant experience, and alignment with role requirements before advancing candidates to the recruiting team

  • Share market insights and candidate feedback with recruiters and hiring managers

  • Support the recruiting team with projects, such as testing new outreach approaches and tracking sourcing metrics

  • Provide a timely, friendly, and respectful experience to every candidate you engage

  • 2+ years of experience sourcing for business or GTM roles

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the team

We help enable Plaid’s goals by drafting and negotiating all varieties of Plaid commercial agreements, including sell-side/go-to-market (GTM), buy-side (procurement), product partnerships, and consumer data access. We advise our business partners on commercial strategies and narratives regarding core and insight products, with a goal of accelerating revenue creation while appropriately addressing and mitigating legal and business risks.

About the role

  • Review and negotiate revenue-generating agreements, including our Master Services Agreement (MSA) and its associated product-specific terms and commercial-focused order forms.

  • Be a principal Legal partner to business stakeholders of all levels regarding the practical contours of their commercial transactions.

  • Help our team continue to evolve our processes, templates, and strategies relative to changing industry and regulatory standards and expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Independently negotiate and close significant GTM deals with sophisticated Enterprise and large Fintech clients, including on counterparty paper.

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Plaid’s products and privacy positions, particularly in relation to evolving industry and regulatory expectations.

  • Build deep relationships with key business and legal stakeholders, fostering open lines of feedback.

Qualifications

  • JD

  • Law firm and/or in-house legal experience drafting and negotiating technology-focused services agreements involving sensitive data and fast-paced stakeholders.

  • “Plaid mentality,” particularly:

    • growth/impact & ownership mindset;

    • positive attitude;

    • low ego, collaborative;

    • desire to build, progress, “make it better,” and seek (i.e., reason and test) your own good answers before asking others; and

    • excellent legal and business judgment (e.g., issue spotting).

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong organization, task management, and process-focused approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a large sales organization on revenue-generating agreements.

  • Experience with customers who are in regulated industries (e.g., public sector; healthcare)

  • Fluency in negotiating with sophisticated enterprise and regulated financial institution customers.

  • Both in-house and law firm experience.

  • Experience with complex (e.g., high value, sophisticated parties, emerging technologies, sensitive data) technology transactions on counterparty paper.

  • Strong understanding of state and federal data privacy laws and industry standards.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Workplace Operations team strives to create world class office spaces, environments and experiences for our employees, including creating environments that support collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a sense of connection to Plaid’s culture.

In this role you'll keep Plaid's San Francisco and Seattle offices running day to day, so the space works for the people who use it, whether they're in every day or a few days a month. That means owning the practical details: how the office is laid out and maintained, how vendors and building management are managed, how programs operate, visitors are greeted, and how health, safety and emergency readiness are planned and rehearsed. You'll also manage the office budget and the contracts behind it, and report on what the space costs and how it's used, so decisions rest on data rather than guesses.

You'll partner with the Security, IT, Legal and People teams to keep the offices in line with company policy and local regulations. You'll manage and develop a team of 3 people across SF and SEA and support their growth.

 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day operations in the SF and Seattle offices, and their various office-related projects. Ensure the offices are clean, organized, and running smooth operations for a positive employee experience

  • Lead programming in their offices for Food & Beverage, Office Health & Safety, Janitorial, Adds, Moves & Changes, Guest Services, and Employee Experience

  • Managing three direct reports across SF (2) and Seattle (1)

  • Manage all workplace vendors, confidently sourcing and onboarding new vendors as needed.

  • Work with Security, IT, Legal and People teams on health, safety, emergency preparedness and access control, and keep the records that auditors and regulators may request up to date.

  • Lead and develop 3 Workplace Ops team members by setting clear goals and delivering consistent feedback

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of experience in Office Management, Facilities or a similar role.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience managing people and teams.

  • Expert understanding of facilities operations, space planning, and vendor management.

  • Strong customer service orientation and experience handling workplace requests and issues.

  • Ability to bring fresh ideas and lead them through to execution and implementation

  • Exceptional organization, documentation, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to tailor messages effectively to different audiences.

  • Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with ticketing systems and triaging Workplace requests.

  • Appetite for growth and a proactive approach to learning.

Nice-to-have

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid Payments is building the infrastructure that makes paying from a bank account as simple and as trusted as paying with a card — at better economics for everyone involved. We verify that an account is real and safe to debit, we score the risk of Billions in transactions a month against more than a thousand signals drawn from the Plaid network, and we move billions of dollars a month across ACH, RTP, and FedNow. Our customers range from the largest billers in the country to fintechs moving money in real time. We are in the middle of a shift from selling payment primitives that customers assemble themselves to selling payment decisions: a turnkey verification engine, guaranteed payments where Plaid takes on the risk, and fully managed payment flows. That shift is what takes bank payments from a cheaper alternative to a better one.

You'll lead Plaid's Payments engineering organization—three teams covering account verification, payment risk, and money movement—partnering with our Product Area Lead to co-own the strategy and execution of one of Plaid's largest and fastest-growing businesses. You'll manage three engineering managers, own the engineering hiring bar, and set technical direction across a platform where reliability and correctness carry real financial weight. You'll decide where to invest in foundations versus ship product. You'll work closely with data science on the ML models behind our risk products, with operations and compliance on regulated money movement, and with go-to-market on key deals and customer relationships. This is a role for someone who wants the whole problem: the systems, the people, and the business.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Set engineering strategy for Payments in partnership with the Product Area Lead, balancing product delivery against foundational investment across three teams.

  • Manage three engineering managers — coach them, calibrate performance, and build the management bench.

  • Own technical direction for the payments platform: verification infrastructure, the Signal risk platform and its ML and data pipelines, money movement rails, and customer-facing APIs and dashboards.

  • Hold the reliability bar for systems where failures move money incorrectly.

  • Drive recruiting and hiring across the org; set the bar and own pipeline health.

  • Drive overall strategy of the product area together with Product leadership.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, data science, PMM, GTM, payment operations, compliance, and customers.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience and 4+ years in engineering management, including 1+ years managing managers.

  • Experience leading an engineering organization of 20+ through an EM layer.

  • Experience owning transactional, high-reliability systems where correctness and availability have direct financial consequences.

  • Track record of building technical foundations that created compounding returns.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, data, operations, and business teams as a true partner.

  • Nice to have: bank payments experience (ACH, RTP, FedNow, or card rails), experience shipping ML-powered risk or fraud products, and experience leading AI transformation in an engineering org.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Agent Trust
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team
The Fraud team is building the largest network of trusted identities in the US. We help customers onboard legitimate users and stop bad actors before they cause downstream harm. Our products span the risk lifecycle: Identity Verification and Monitor for onboarding and compliance, and Protect, our fraud intelligence platform.

 

We are extending that network to AI agents. Agents are starting to open accounts, link accounts, move money, and transfer between wallets for consumers. The protocols forming around them standardize how an agent identifies itself and what it may do, and leave the question of whether to trust it to the business on the receiving end. Agent Trust, our Know Your Agent (KYA) product, answers it, on top of the identity, consent, and risk infrastructure Plaid already runs.

 

You will take over Agent Trust: the decision on whether an action an AI agent takes on a financial account can be trusted. You will define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the people behind them, and evaluates what they are authorized to do, and how that connects to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permissions. You will sell that decision to financial institutions and to Plaid customers, and you will carry Plaid’s requirements into the standards bodies shaping this space, with the fraud engineering and data teams behind you.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and OKRs for Agent Trust. Decide what Plaid offers, to whom, and how it is packaged and priced.

  • Define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the humans behind them, and evaluates what they are allowed to do, for new accounts and existing ones.

  • Connect Agent Trust to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permission management, with the product teams that own those surfaces.

  • Work directly with financial institutions and Plaid customers as the product expert: discovery, design partnerships, and GTM enablement.

  • Represent Plaid’s product requirements in the industry groups and protocol working groups writing the specs for agent identity and authorization, with Partnerships and Legal.

  • Partner with data science and engineering on what the product needs: signals, labels, success metrics, and the requirements that tie them together.

     

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of product management or equivalent product ownership, with meaningful time in fraud, identity, authentication, or payments risk

  • Hands-on depth in identity and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.x and OIDC, FIDO and WebAuthn, FDX or Open Banking consent), or in bot, device, and agent detection systems

  • Track record of growing a new product line, from early design partners and first customers to repeatable sales

  • Experience building with and selling to enterprise customers or financial institutions

  • Clear writing, and the ability to translate between protocol engineers, data scientists, GTM, and executives

You will sell that decision to financial institutions and to Plaid customers, and you will carry Plaid’s requirements into the standards bodies shaping this space, with the fraud engineering and data teams behind you.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and OKRs for Agent Trust. Decide what Plaid offers, to whom, and how it is packaged and priced.

 - Define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the humans behind them, and evaluates what they are allowed to do, for new accounts and existing ones.

 - Connect Agent Trust to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permission management, with the product teams that own those surfaces.

 - Work directly with financial institutions and Plaid customers as the product expert: discovery, design partnerships, and GTM enablement.

 - Represent Plaid’s product requirements in the industry groups and protocol working groups writing the specs for agent identity and authorization, with Partnerships and Legal.

 - Partner with data science and engineering on what the product needs: signals, labels, success metrics, and the requirements that tie them together.
   
    

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of product management or equivalent product ownership, with meaningful time in fraud, identity, authentication, or payments risk

 - Hands-on depth in identity and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.x and OIDC, FIDO and WebAuthn, FDX or Open Banking consent), or in bot, device, and agent detection systems

 - Track record of growing a new product line, from early design partners and first customers to repeatable sales

 - Experience building with and selling to enterprise customers or financial institutions

 - Clear writing, and the ability to translate between protocol engineers, data scientists, GTM, and executives

Nice to have:

 - Direct work on agentic protocols or programs (MCP, A2A, AP2, ACP, UCP, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agentic Tokens, Verifiable Intent)

 - Standards-body participation (FDX, FIDO Alliance, OpenID Foundation, Linux Foundation, W3C)

 - KYC, reusable identity, or digital wallet product experience

 - Former founder or entrepreneurial track record

jobs.title: Sales Engineer - Banking and Wealth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

In this role, you’ll work closely with our growing Banking and Wealth Sales team as the technical lead during the pre-sales process. You will be responsible for partnering with Account Executives, proactively pushing deals forward by overcoming technical objections and evangelizing Plaid solutions to technical and executive stakeholders. You will guide customers through thorough technical scoping, ensuring foundational architectural decisions set customers up for long-term success. You can effectively pivot from technical discussions to business value conversations focusing on customer outcomes. You will ensure a successful transition to the post-sale stage of the customer lifecycle and partner with account teams to drive adoption of new products by existing customers. You will be expected to have significant knowledge of the financial services industry and a deep understanding of how clients can best utilize Plaid.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead technical product lead for B&W accounts throughout the sales process

  • Partner with Account Executives as the technical lead for Enterprise accounts to to design solutions and share best practices throughout the sales process

  • Demonstrate to prospects how Plaid can best address their use cases and technical requirements

  • Engage deeply with technical stakeholders in the pre-sales process to drive alignment and buy-in

  • Provide demonstrations, address technical questions, architect implementation solution(s) and handle RFP responses in a thorough and expedient manner

  • Take a hands-on role in POCs, where inquisitive and critical thinking is needed to identify, diagnose, and rectify any performance shortfalls

  • Constantly re-evaluate selling assets and process to enable more efficient/effective messaging to customers

  • Work with our engineering and product teams to translate prospect feedback into meaningful product insights

  • Collaborate with current SE team to up-level team knowledge and capabilities

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of customer facing experience selling to large enterprises, including experience in financial services or selling to financial services companies

  • Knowledge in payments, fraud, risk, preferred

  • Experience that combines business experience and technical acumen

  • Strong sense of customer empathy

  • Consultative selling approach

  • Strong communications skills with a confident and proactive approach to client management.

  • Intellectually curious, with a focus on using AI to scale impact

  • Familiar with web services, APIs, and standards like HTTP and REST

  • Understanding of mobile and web app architecture for API integration

  • Willing and able to travel up to 25% of the time

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

jobs.title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineer - Credit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Role

As the Manager of Machine Learning Engineering on the Credit team, you’ll lead the team responsible for Plaid’s LendScore and Income Insights products. You’ll manage and develop a team of Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists, set direction for advancing our insights, and partner with Engineering, Product, and other Data teams to deliver customer and business impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, support, and develop a team of Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists working across credit insights products.

  • Set technical and product direction for evolving LendScore and Income Insights, including the team’s machine learning roadmap.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data teams to prioritize opportunities and deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

  • Guide the development of machine learning models across the full lifecycle, from experimentation and offline training to online serving and monitoring.

  • Help the team tackle both 0-to-1 opportunities and the scaling and improvement of established products.

  • Foster a high-ownership, bottom-up team culture grounded in data-driven decisions and business impact.


What Excites You

  • Leading work that can expand access to financial services for millions of people through well-known and emerging fintech applications.

  • Developing products and insights that support the next wave of cash-flow-based underwriting.

  • Helping a talented team experiment with modern machine learning techniques and bring them into production.

  • Shaping a roadmap that spans new 0-to-1 opportunities and scaling solutions that are already delivering value.

  • Working across Data, Engineering, and Product in a high-ownership environment where the team’s work can drive meaningful impact.


What Excites Us

  • 8+ years of experience training and serving AI or machine learning models in production environments.

  • Experience leading a team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers.

  • Experience in fintech lending and a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending.

  • Experience building or working with data-intensive backend applications in large, distributed systems.

  • Ability to code and iterate independently using data infrastructure tools such as Python, Spark, Jupyter notebooks, and standard machine learning libraries.

  • A track record of taking ownership and driving projects to business impact.

  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a closely related field.

  • Nice to have: Experience in data analytics or data engineering.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!
